title: Task Acceptance Criteria Schema
description: Validates the acceptance criteria object for a single task.

task_id.description: Task identifier this criteria set belongs to.

criteria.description: Array of acceptance criteria for this task. Minimum 1.

criterion_id.description: Unique acceptance criterion identifier in AC-NNN format.

description.description: Clear, testable description of what must be true for this criterion to pass.

is_blocking.description: If true, this criterion must pass before the task is considered complete. Blocking criteria cannot be deferred.

prd_criterion_id.description: Optional reference to the originating PRD acceptance criterion.

notes.description: Optional clarifying notes for the dev agent or QA reviewer.
